trap.label: to + substantivo
trap.wrong: That brings me for my second point.
trap.right: That brings me to my second point.
trap.why: Em português “nos traz ao/para o segundo ponto” oscila entre preposições. Em inglês, bring someone to a point.

mcq.q: Which phrase links your talk to the next part?

fix.wrong: By June we will have been talk for a year.
fix.right: By June we will have been talking for a year.

fix.wrong: I will pay if you will sign it.
fix.right: I will pay if you will.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva: “By June we talk for a year.” (Future Perfect Continuous)
rewrite.answer: By June we will have been talking for a year.
